frozen_parent_cycle.immutability: verify every manifest output hash before and after cycle2; never write into the parent run

nested_temporal_oof.minimum_history_rule: skip forecast years until the earlier fit rows contain all three classes
nested_temporal_oof.validation_use: select_alpha_and_policy_only; never fit correction or calibration
nested_temporal_oof.test_use: evaluation_only; never select alpha threshold policy or features

c6.baseline_model: cycle1 multinomial logistic calendar model with median imputer indicators, scaler and C=0.1
c6.baseline_semantics: CatBoost Pool baseline receives raw C0 formula values exactly once; inference predicts correction without baseline and composes explicitly
c6.alpha_zero: return C0 probabilities exactly and reuse the unchanged C0 policy without threshold reselection in the identity check
c6.missing_weather: set correction to zero before composition and use exact C0 logits and probabilities; keep one continuous notification state

calibration_only.definition: regularized multinomial calibration correction over OOF C0 raw logits

periodic.diagnostic_k17: report_all_17_fixed_phases; never choose the best external phase

scopes.paired_candidate_days_v3: retain the exact cycle1 candidate_comparison_complete scenario and its full uncompressed calendar state
scopes.service_calendar_with_C0_fallback: score every service-active day with one state machine; use C0 where episode weather is unavailable

policy_modes.c0_policy_replay: reuse exact cycle1 C0 threshold active_days and cooldown per outer fold and scope
policy_modes.validation_selected: jointly choose alpha and a threshold using outer validation only

selection_constraints.threshold_candidates: cycle1 fixed grid 0.05..0.95 plus 1.000001 and validation score quantiles

uncertainty.interpretation: descriptive across few observed years; does not include full model-selection or disease-registration uncertainty

diagnostics.funnel: yearly all first events to after entry to warnable to primary registration period to common weather to hit, plus field-seasons days and explicit loss reasons
diagnostics.polyakov: report service coverage and conditional/scorable performance separately; distinguish weather from BBCH availability
diagnostics.c4_optuna: describe saved trials and fixed-versus-tuned outcomes only; no external reselection

prohibited: change endpoint label window splits censoring cutoff or budgets for results
future weather phenology visits or labels
notification state reset at weather gaps or evaluation masks
